name: What is the best paint sheen for interior baseboards and trim?

mainEntity.name: What is the best paint sheen for interior baseboards and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Semi-gloss and satin are the most common sheens for interior trim, baseboards, and door casings. Semi-gloss provides a durable, moisture-resistant finish that resists scuffs and wipes down easily, making it the practical choice for high-traffic baseboards and bathroom molding. Satin offers a softer, lower-reflective look that conceals minor surface dents better than high-gloss finishes while still allowing routine cleaning. The tradeoff comes down to durability versus imperfection concealment: higher gloss resists abrasion but highlights every wood gouge, whereas lower sheen softens flaws but requires gentler scrubbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-gloss is best for maximum scuff resistance and easy cleaning. Satin provides a softer look that hides minor wood imperfections while remaining wipeable.
